svg.aria-label: I understand the business first. Then I build what it needs. Data and business analyst in Harare, Zimbabwe, with an insurance and pensions background. I combine data analytics, automation and software development to solve practical business problems. Not every problem needs AI. The goal is the right solution for the job.
